summary: Change review lays out the edits an agent made as a file list beside a diff, so a person can go through them one change at a time. Each hunk gets its own Keep and Undo buttons, and any line can carry a question back to the agent.
use: When an agent has edited several files and a person should approve the work before it lands.
When some changes are right and others are not, and people need to keep part of the work.
When a reviewer wants to ask the agent why it changed a specific line.
When you need a running record of which hunks were kept and which were undone.
features: The side list shows every file with its type label, a status mark (kept, undone or partly decided) and a total of added and removed lines.

Each hunk has a title, coloured add and delete lines with line numbers, and its own Keep and Undo buttons. Keep is the hunk's action, in the accent on a tint of it, and Undo stays quiet beside it. A kept hunk's Keep turns green, and pressing the same choice again clears it.
Undo all and Keep all decide every hunk in the open file. After Keep all, the next file opens by itself.
The plus button on a line opens a field to ask the agent about it. Sending it empty asks "Why this change?" and calls `onComment` with the file, hunk, line and text.
Decisions are stored by hunk `key` and can be left internal or controlled with `decisions` and `onDecisionsChange`.
The open file can be controlled with `file` and `onFileChange`, and `title` replaces the "N files changed" header.
a11y: Files, hunk choices and bulk actions are all real buttons. Each hunk's Keep and Undo carry `aria-pressed`, so the choice made is announced.
Each line's comment button has `aria-label="Comment on line"` and a Comment tooltip, and it shows while it has the keyboard focus, as it does on hover.
The comment field is focused when it opens and has an `aria-label`. Enter sends it and Escape closes it.

faq.q: How do I know which changes the person kept?
faq.a: Read the `decisions` object passed to `onDecisionsChange`. It maps each hunk key to `kept` or `undone`, and hunks with no decision are left out.

faq.q: What is a hunk key if I don't set one?
faq.a: It defaults to the file name plus the hunk's index, like `PricingCard.tsx#0`. Set `key` on a hunk if you need a stable id of your own.

faq.q: How do line questions reach my agent?
faq.a: Handle `onComment`. It receives the file, hunk, line and the question text, and the sent question stays under the line in the diff.

faq.q: Does Undo actually revert the code?
faq.a: No. The component records the decision and greys out the hunk. Applying or reverting the change in your project is up to your own code.
